profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Mindbody | ClimateBase Fellow
profile.summary:
From building the backend of an application to analyzing the societal impacts of new technological systems, I'm a software engineer who's passion lies in pushing technology for the betterment of all people in our world. I'm a fast learner who thrives under a challenge while also creating a positive environment where everyone can contribute.

I look forward to hear from you!

If you are inquiring about opportunities at Mindbody, please only reach out to me on LinkedIn.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Modernizing Mindbody’s frontend platform with Next.js, React.js, TypeScript, and agentic workflows. Developing domain APIs with C# and GraphQL.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Dynamics 365, AI ERP
positions.description:
- Leading effort to improve the stability of background services to fix data corruption on customer environments - Designed and implemented abstract implementation for dynamic chunking of data for existing and future processes using X++ and Claude Code, improving the services’ stability and reducing time to complete
- Analyzed SQL implementations to optimize and fix existing processes
- Created an AI Skill with GitHub CoPilot to build new background services for emerging corruption scenarios
- Knowledge expert on DAMS executions, an internal service to execute SQL scripts on customer environments
- Collaborated across teams to implement a SQL script to proactively fix database indexes for 900+ customer environments and fix existing issues with the processes
- Documented and guided other engineers to implement their scripts and analyze the results 
- Mentored junior engineers to onboard on to the team, lead scrum, and complete work items
- Improving the quality of the product through bug fixes, implementation of telemetry, and working with customers for on call support

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Microsoft Sustainability Manager, AI ERP
positions.description:
Developing the data ingestion, scorecard, and goal features for Microsoft's Sustainability Manager. Our goal is to help companies manage and reduce their carbon footprint and support other sustainability efforts.

- Developed ingestion processes for customers to upload sustainability data with React, TypeScript, C#, CoPilot 
- Lead a team of vendors to increase code coverage of React components and Dataverse plugins tests. Front end increased from 55% to 70%. Backend increased from 68% to 82% 
- Improved quality of the product by conducting on call activities to resolve customer issues, fixing multiple bugs 
related to React components, ingestion processes on the microservice, user accessibility, and more

positions.title: Software Engineer 2, Microsoft Sustainability Manager, Cloud For Sustainability
positions.description: Developing the data ingestion, scorecard, and goal features for Microsoft's Sustainability Manager. Our goal is to help companies manage and reduce their carbon footprint and support other sustainability efforts.

positions.title: Software Engineer 2, Core Marketing Engineering
positions.description:
- Lead an API migration project across three services to write code and onboard to a new API architecture. Moved from Service Fabric to Web App in order to reduce cost by $400 per month, increase security, and reduce maintenance by 20 hours per month 
- Lead Disaster Recovery effort to ensure our systems are resilient during a data center outage 
- Designed process for an engineer to failover to a secondary system within 24 hours 
- Implemented Azure Synapse ETL data pipelines with Python and Spark to update our data from multiple sources 
- Implemented Azure Functions to retrieve marketing campaigns to update customers’ contact information, reducing the time to sync this information from 72 hours to 1 hour
- Served as scrum master to manage features across team members, work with program managers to understand the priority, and organize retrospectives to improve on team performance for each sprint

positions.title: Software Engineer, Core Marketing Engineering
positions.description:
- Developed new component to track potential commercial customers for Microsoft's Commercial Sales & Marketing division
- Implemented stateless API's services to update metadata and manage the GDPR for customer data
- Scrum Master - Assigned tasks to teammates and organizes end-of-sprint retrospectives
- Managed implementation of telemetry across the team’s services
- Oversaw the launch of the product in the EMEA region
- Volunteer for the organization's cultural events, including potlucks and all-hands meetings

positions.title: Climatebase Fellow
positions.description:
- Participant of Cohort 3 of the Climatebase Fellowship
- Attended workshops and leadership talks to improve my understanding of the climate tech space

positions.title: MovingWorlds Institute Global Fellow
positions.description: - Six month program to learn about human centered design and tools for social impact

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
- Implemented Oscar Lab's "Sinter" project in C# designed for programmers with visual impairments
- Enhanced functionalities to improve user interaction with remote applications
- Developed Jenkins platform for the Oscar Lab research group for continuous integration of the Graphene open source project

company.name: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill

positions.title: Senior Extreme Blue Technical Intern
positions.description:
- Developed automated bots to encourage modern developer habits under the mentorship of IBM Whitewater
- Goal was to enhance IBM developers’ use of code reviews from Agile practices
- Programmed the bot server using Botkit and Node.js, handling the interaction flow between the bot and the user
- Medium Article: https://medium.com/@connie.mari.yee/29ae8a53f1ed
- IBM NA Twitter: https://twitter.com/IBMNAjobs/status/895639149885231105?s=04

positions.title: Networks Research Assistant
positions.locationName: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill
positions.description:
- Research into efficient ways to form a large mesh network out of commercial aircraft.
- Develops and runs simulations on NS-3.
- Focusing on enhancing the distributed programming of the simulations.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Develops open source, middleware services for Open Services for Lifecycle Collaboration (OSLC) in Node.js, Express.js, and more.
- Classifies API routes using Swagger.io and YAML.
- Adapted services to use Apache Jena Fuseki and MongoDB databases.

positions.title: Google Student Ambassador to UNC-Chapel Hill
positions.description:
- Acted as a liaison between Google headquarters and UNC-Chapel Hill for the 2014-2015 academic year. 
- Had the role as the campus contact for Google. Hosted Google events on campus.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Developing for the Rational Developer for z Systems using Java and Eclipse.
- Priority was to repair JUnit testers to advance testing automation, as well as to resolve defects in RDz.
- Conducted a four-week study on the code coverage of RDz's JUnit testers on their respective target code.

company.name: The University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill

positions.title: Computer Software Research Assistant
positions.description:
- Developed computer games that allow users to customize their own educational video games for the disabled.
- Three versions were programmed: two in Python and Pygame (switch users, visually impaired users) and JavaScript and Quintus (visually impaired users).
- The latter version in JavaScript, "Arithiga," was displayed at Maze Day 2015, a day where visually impaired children come to the Computer Science Department to play computer games.

positions.title: Department Support
positions.description:
- Provided support for faculty and department events. 
- Assisted faculty in updating portions of departmental websites.
